 if typ==22:
  p=off+5; end=off+5+ln

   ht=b[p]; hl=int.from_bytes(b[p+1:p+4],'big')
   print('  hs off',p,'type',hex(ht),'len',hl,'end',p+4+hl)

   p+=4+hl
 off+=5+ln; rec+=1
 if off>=len(b)-2: print('trailing',len(b)-off, b[off:].hex()); break
